item.angelring_pb.angel_ring.tooltip.cur: Grants creative flight while carried or worn in a ring slot
jei.angelring_pb.angel_ring.info: Grants creative flight while you carry it anywhere in your inventory, hotbar or hands, or wear it in a Curios ring slot. Double-tap jump to take off. Flight ends when the ring is removed. A ring stored inside a backpack, bundle or shulker box does not count.
